item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
What's New in v1.0.0

✨ Open WebUI, Simplified

  • No-code setup experience: Install, launch, and access Open WebUI on macOS without manually configuring Python environments, virtual environments, or local server commands.
  • Native macOS launcher: Open WebUI can now be started and accessed through a dedicated macOS application that automatically monitors the local server and opens the interface when ready.
  • Streamlined local workflow: Designed to reduce setup friction and make self-hosted AI accessible to users who prefer a desktop application experience over manual Terminal-based workflows.

‼️ Important Notice

  • This application is not Open WebUI itself: It is a macOS launcher and frontend host for a standard Open WebUI installation. No modifications are made to the Open WebUI product, source code, backend, or functionality.
  • All Open WebUI features remain provided by the original project: Credit for the platform, web interface, backend services, and ongoing development belongs entirely to the Open WebUI team and contributors.

🔧 Reliability & Stability

  • Includes startup monitoring, installation workflow improvements, UI refinements, and stability enhancements for a smoother and more dependable experience.

Feedback

Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome through GitHub Issues.

Thank you for using Open WebUI for macOS.
